subject: computer-science

items.q: When is an AND gate's output true?
items.correct: Only when all its inputs are true.
items.misconception: When at least one input is true.
items.random_wrong: Only when all inputs are false.
items.why: AND needs every input true; OR needs at least one true.

items.q: What does a NOT gate do?
items.random_wrong: Takes two inputs and adds them.
items.why: NOT (inverter) flips one input to its opposite.
